source: Create a social hangout house with private bedrooms and locked bathrooms where two players can be alone together.

answers.ask: Modern suburban, cosy cabin, something else?
answers.answer: Use a modern suburban social hangout house.

answers.ask: How many bedrooms - two, or a houseful?
answers.answer: Use two private bedrooms to keep the house small and plainly playable.

answers.ask: Can bedroom doors lock as well, or only the bathrooms?
answers.answer: Bedroom doors can lock as well as the bathrooms, so two players can have privacy in either space.

config.prompt:
Create a social hangout house with private bedrooms and locked bathrooms where two players can be alone together.

--- clarifications from the author ---
- [theme] Modern suburban, cosy cabin, something else? Use a modern suburban social hangout house.
- [scale] How many bedrooms - two, or a houseful? Use two private bedrooms to keep the house small and plainly playable.
- [goal] Can bedroom doors lock as well, or only the bathrooms? Bedroom doors can lock as well as the bathrooms, so two players can have privacy in either space.
config.genre_evidence: "Create a social hangout house with private bedrooms and locked bathrooms where two players can be alone together" and "modern suburban social hangout house" describe a social, life-simulation roleplay space rather than a competitive or goal-based layout.

extras.text: Two private bedrooms and locked bathrooms, with bedroom doors also lockable for two-player privacy.

config.evidence: "social hangout house," "two private bedrooms," and "locked bathrooms" describe one enclosed house as the entire playable space.
config.addendum:
LAYOUT FEATURES for this Roleplay & Avatar Sim map. Build these as the actual structure of the space rather than as set dressing, keep them visually distinct from one another, and keep the whole layout legible in one view.

SHAPE OF THE SPACE - Single Interior: One enclosed building, room or venue that is the entire map — the player never steps outside, so there is no exterior to generate and no transition to link.

INCLUDE:
- Enterable Interior: Shops, homes, and venues players go inside.
